title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Protocol Error Enforcement Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for DoQ one-query protocol-error enforcement.
scope: This verification covers non-zero received DNS Message IDs, STREAM FIN before the declared DoQ message length is complete, and more than one client query on a server-side stream. It does not cover multi-response count enforcement, peer STOP_SENDING to the client, missing expected FIN timeout policy, EDNS keepalive, unidirectional stream fatal errors, or server-initiated bidirectional stream fatal errors.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation, stream lifecycle, and cancellation/resource-limit slices exist.
The local managed QUIC loopback support is available for malformed stream tests.
expected_result: The focused DoQ stream lifecycle and RFC 9250 requirement-home tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The one-query DoQ path now proves `DOQ_PROTOCOL_ERROR` enforcement for non-zero DNS Message ID, incomplete DoQ frames, and multiple queries on one stream.
